summary: REAL browser Razorpay TEST-mode checkout verified end-to-end on the public preview URL. Customer login -> add in-stock product -> Checkout -> select serviceable address (520003) -> select 'Pay Online (Razorpay)' -> Place order opened the genuine Razorpay iframe popup (Test Mode banner, amount 759 matching create-order amount 75900 paise, key_id rzp_test_TRvKLkUvlTYS4b). Card payment was completed inside the third-party iframe (contact 9820098200, card 5267 3181 8797 5449, exp 12/34, CVV 123, email, 'Maybe later' on save-card, OTP 1111). POST /api/payments/razorpay/verify returned {"status":"paid"}, toast 'Payment successful!' showed, cart cleared, app navigated to /orders/<id>: order FG260800039 shows 'Order Confirmed' + 'Payment: Online (Razorpay) - Paid' + 'Total paid Rs.759', and it appears as 'Order Confirmed' in My Orders. FAILURE path: an order placed and then left un-paid (popup abandoned) stayed 'Order Placed'/pending (FG260800040) and was never marked paid. SECURITY: no key_secret and no rzp_live anywhere in page source or in any /api/* response payload; only the publishable key_id is exposed. NOTE: Razorpay test card 4111 1111 1111 1111 is REJECTED by this test account with 'International cards are not supported' - use the domestic test card 5267 3181 8797 5449 instead.

minor.issue: Min-order rule compares against subtotal only (Rs.155 subtotal + Rs.60 delivery = Rs.215 shown as 'Pay Rs.215') and rejects with 'Minimum order value is Rs.199' after the user clicks Pay - error surfaces too late and the message does not say what is missing.

Address/location PIN mismatch (default address PIN 500034 under the Vijayawada/520003 location) is only rejected at order time with 'Sorry, we don't deliver to this PIN code yet.' - not flagged when the address is selected.

Every abandoned Razorpay attempt leaves a permanent pending order. This test run created 14 orphan pending online orders (FG260800027-FG260800038, FG260800040). No expiry/cleanup for unpaid online orders.

ui_bugs.issue: Razorpay prefill is incomplete/invalid: no prefill.email is passed, so Razorpay adds an extra 'Enter Email' step; prefill.contact ('+919876543210') is not accepted by Razorpay and the 'Contact details' modal is shown on every attempt (Razorpay also rejects 9876543210 as 'Please enter a valid mobile number'). Pass prefill {name, email: user.email, contact: 10-digit number}.
No modal.ondismiss / payment.failed handler. Closing or abandoning the Razorpay popup leaves the user sitting on Checkout with no message, cart intact and an orphan pending order in My Orders.
No client-side pre-validation of minimum order value; the CTA reads 'Pay Rs.215' and only a server 400 toast explains the failure.
React console error: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' - order/product thumbnails render with empty src (same issue reported in iteration_16, still open).

integration_issues.issue: On one run, /checkout rendered 'Your cart is empty' while the header cart badge showed 2 items (no loading guard while GET /api/cart resolves); reproduced once out of several attempts (intermittent).

issues: Leftover 'Swap Test Combo' line item renders with price Rs.0 and a clipped overlapping thumbnail/title; the combo is also not listed in the Checkout order summary.

action_items: Pass a valid Razorpay prefill: {name, email: <user email>, contact: <10-digit phone without +91>} so the popup goes straight to payment options.
Add modal: { ondismiss } and a payment.failed handler in Checkout.js to toast 'Payment cancelled' and navigate to the pending order (or cancel/release it).
Add cleanup/expiry for unpaid online orders and remove the 14 orphan pending test orders FG260800027-FG260800038 and FG260800040.
Client-side validate minimum order value (and show 'Add Rs.X more') plus address PIN serviceability at selection time instead of failing at Pay.
Update internal test docs: Razorpay test card 4111 1111 1111 1111 fails on this account ('International cards are not supported'); use domestic card 5267 3181 8797 5449 with OTP 1111.
Fix empty img src on order/checkout thumbnails (carry-over from iteration_16).
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.js razorpay branch has no failure handling: only options.handler (success) is defined - no modal.ondismiss, no rzp.on('payment.failed'), so all non-success outcomes are silent.
setPlacing(false) is called both in the razorpay early-return and the finally block; harmless but redundant.
Cart items/total are rendered before the cart fetch resolves, allowing a false 'Your cart is empty' state on direct /checkout loads.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only run; all /api calls observed returned 200 except the two expected 400 validation cases)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the Razorpay success + abandon paths

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright recipe that works for the real Razorpay popup: after clicking place-order-btn, grab the frame whose url contains 'api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public'; fill input[name="contact"]:visible (must use press_sequentially, fill() trips Razorpay validation), click button:has-text("Continue"):visible last; then press_sequentially card.number/card.expiry/card.cvv and dispatch_event('click') on [data-test-id="add-card-cta"] (normal click times out); an email field then appears (input[type=email]) -> submit again; click 'Maybe later' on the save-card prompt; then type OTP 1111 into input[placeholder="Enter OTP"] and dispatch_event('click') on Continue. Use address PIN 520003 for the Vijayawada location and keep subtotal >= Rs.199.
rca_of_the_issue: The extra Razorpay 'Contact details' and 'Enter Email' steps are caused by Checkout.js passing prefill.contact='+919876543210' (rejected by Razorpay validation) and no prefill.email. The 'International cards are not supported' failure is a Razorpay account-level restriction on the 4111... BIN, not an app defect; the domestic test card completes 3DS/OTP and the verify endpoint correctly flips the order to paid/confirmed.
